{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit pullover, softly fitted V-neck, hip length, long sleeves, dusty blue #7fa6c8, merino wool

Skirt, A-line, just below the knee, gently flared, deep navy #1f2a44, wool crepe

Jacket, single-breasted, slightly shaped, hip length, one-button closure, charcoal blue #3a4256, textured wool bouclé

Coat (outer layer for the cool autumn evening), straight cut, knee length, notch lapel, heather grey #5b6170, wool-cashmere blend

Sheer tights, matte, ink navy #232a3d, fine knit nylon

Ankle boots, almond toe, 5 cm block heel, navy #1f2a44, smooth suede

Scarf, light, worn loosely at the neck, burgundy #7a2e3f, silk-wool blend

Handbag, small structured crossbody, burgundy #6b2737, smooth leather

Earrings, small studs, soft pearl #f1ece4, with a silver-tone setting #c0c4cc

This outfit sits in the neat, classic register that suits an evening at the theatre: a refined knit, a textured jacket, a skirt and ankle boots, all quiet and restrained. The dusty blue knit echoes her eyes and, together with the navy and charcoal tones, flatters her fair skin and silvery hair without competing with them. The burgundy scarf and bag add one warm accent that feels deliberate rather than loud. The tonal navy from skirt to tights to boots creates a long, continuous line, while the coat keeps her comfortable on the way to and from the 19:00 performance."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2414,"output_tokens":1336},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
